visualCharacteristics: White rounded panel with generous padding and centred text: an optional plain link with a download icon, a full-width image, a large heading, a lead paragraph and a big button.
contentPattern: One cell: optional plain link paragraph, image, heading (h1 or h2), one or more paragraphs, and a bold-italic link rendered as the big button.
usage: Opening banner panel at the top of the homepage and listing pages (bikes, gear, gifts).
reuseGuidance: Use for a page's introductory banner with an image, title, lead text and one main call to action. Elements are placed by role, so authors can omit the event link, image or button.
